subject: MAP: SOC 2 evidence timeline & security review owners (FinPath)
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finpath.com>; Peter Liu <peter.liu@finpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (security milestone & SOC 2 evidence)

Hi Emily / Peter —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier. Per our discovery call I captured the MAP draft and attached a concise evidence checklist to make the security intake predictable for your procurement and compliance teams. High-level recap and asks: 

- Target commercial close: 2026-09-24 (proposal + standard SOW) — adjustable if compliance needs more runway.
- Security milestone (this thread): FinPath to complete our SOC 2 evidence intake + questionnaire by 2026-08-20. Redwood delivers redacted SOC 2 pre-read and controls mapping by 2026-08-13.
- Dependencies: (1) your internal compliance gate for third-party onboarding (timeline TBD), (2) Redwood providing sample evidence for encryption-at-rest and key-rotation logs.

Attachments included: MAP_v1_FinPath.xlsx (milestone owners + dates), SOC2_Questionnaire_FINPATH_2026.pdf, evidence_list_template.csv. Please confirm owners and whether the 08/20 evidence cut is feasible for you.

Next concrete steps I propose: 
1) Emily to confirm evidence owners for each line item by EOD 2026-08-04.
2) Redwood (Sergio) to prepare sample logs and a 1-page controls mapping by 2026-08-13.
3) Ben / Marissa to schedule a 30-min joint intake with your compliance team the week of 08/09 if needed.

If any item needs escalation, we'll surface in the MAP as a blocker with mitigation (e.g., limited-data pilot).

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP_v1_FinPath.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_Questionnaire_FINPATH_2026.pdf (PDF), evidence_list_template.csv (CSV)

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finpath.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Liu <peter.liu@finpath.com>, compliance@finpath.com
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (security milestone & SOC 2 evidence)

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. Quick feedback from our side after an internal sync: 

- The 08/20 evidence cut is aggressive for some of our teams (legal + vendor security). Realistically we can commit to 08/27 for the full evidence package, but we can surface high-priority items earlier if Redwood can provide concrete sample evidence for encryption and key-management.
- Owners: I can own application architecture evidence and encryption controls. Peter will own vendor-risk and procurement items. Our compliance alias will triage the questionnaire. Expect a formal owner list by EOD 08/04.
- We need a clear mapping of "required vs optional" evidence rows in your template. Procurement will reject any intake that looks like 'best effort'.

Questions: 
1) Can Redwood provide redacted key-rotation logs, KMS policy, and an architecture inventory sample by 08/13 as you suggested?
2) Does Redwood support hosting in a dedicated VPC for regulated workloads (we want note in MAP if required)?

We agree a 30-min intake call would help — open the week of 08/09.

I'll send the owner confirmations shortly.

Regards,
Emily Zhang
Head of Security & Compliance | FinPath
emily.zhang@finpath.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finpath.com>; Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (security milestone & SOC 2 evidence)

Emily — appreciate the quick sync and context. A few clarifying points from the commercial side so we keep the MAP actionable: 

- We can accept a revised evidence cut of 2026-08-27 provided the following are met: (A) Redwood delivers redacted examples for encryption-at-rest and key rotation by 2026-08-13, (B) FinPath flags any "hard blockers" by 2026-08-19 so the deal cadence isn't blocked unexpectedly.
- On "required vs optional" labeling: Ava will update the MAP_v1 spreadsheet to include a status column (Required / Optional / Mitigating Evidence) and a checkbox for whether FinPath needs the artifact before signature.
- Dedicated VPC note: Redwood does support Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments. We'll add a MAP milestone to confirm deployment mode by 2026-08-20. If FinPath requires a private deployment, that will move the target close to the right (we should plan for a 4–6 week onboarding buffer).

Action items assigned: 
- Ava: update the MAP sheet with Required/Optional classification and send an updated link by EOD 08/05.
- Sergio: can you confirm whether we can provide redacted key-rotation logs and a short KMS policy export by 08/13? If there are constraints, note the minimum acceptable artifact.
- Marissa: please draft a 30-min invite for the week of 08/09 to loop in FinPath compliance.

We'll keep the proposal timeline flexible until compliance signs off — thanks for partnering on a pragmatic plan.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finpath.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (security milestone & SOC 2 evidence)

Emily / team —

Confirming Redwood can provide the following by 2026-08-13: 
- Redacted key-rotation logs (last 90 days) with a short README describing retention policy and redaction method.
- KMS policy export (text) showing rotation schedule and access principals.
- 1-page controls mapping that ties the SOC 2 sections in our report to the questionnaire rows you sent.

Notes / limitations: we cannot disclose unredacted private keys or full audit logs. For items that require live access (e.g., SIEM searches), we can provide query output samples and signed attestation from our Security Ops. If FinPath needs a dedicated VPC for regulated data, let's mark that as a separate MAP milestone — Redwood will need an SOW addendum for Private deployment.

I'll drop the artifacts to the Drive link in Ben/Ava's MAP and ping your compliance alias when uploaded. If FinPath confirms owners by EOD 08/04, I'll prioritize the artifacts accordingly.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com

Attachment stubs referenced: sample_key_rotation_log_redacted.txt (stub), kms_policy_export.txt (stub), controls_mapping_onepager.pdf (stub)
